integrity: Computational checks cover listed finite prime powers only; uniform theorem relies on mathematical proof. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only rank-four first-order theories of Paley tournaments and the prenex-existential fragment; it does not classify all finite tournaments or arbitrary higher ranks. Classical Hasse–Weil bound is assumed. Relevant 3-e.c. properties were known. Unindexed prior logical classifications remain a possible overlap.
title: Four rank-four theories of Paley tournaments over prime-power fields, with an existential-fragment gap
